\section[cirikkuka]{\ml{ചിരിക്കുക} (cirikkuka) — to laugh}

\label{lesson:ML-C173-cirikkuka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to call, then the Malayalam for to cry.

Say \textquotedblleft{}him,\textquotedblright{} as the one it happens to. (\emph{Avane}.)
\end{quote}
